name: king-of-pirates
description: Black Basta — a pirate-themed cybersecurity CTF hosting platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,yellow "npm run demo -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
